description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Parallel builds web infrastructure that businesses use to create AI agents. The Early Career Software Engineer will improve the developer experience by building product features and backend systems, gathering developer feedback, and owning projects from idea through launch.
Early Career Software Engineer building developer-facing features and backend billing and entitlement systems, incorporating developer feedback

Responsibilities:
• Build and ship product features that make it fast and intuitive for developers to build on Parallel
• Design and build the backend systems behind our developer facing product, including billing and entitlements
• Talk with developers, understand where they get stuck, and turn that feedback into improvements
• Own projects end to end, from idea to launch, alongside a small team of experienced engineers

Requirements:
• A BS or MS in Computer Science or a related field
• You have built and shipped something with AI, whether at an internship, in a project, or on your own
• Strong software engineering fundamentals and comfort working across the backend and product
• Strong product sense and genuine excitement about building tools for developers
• Curiosity, humility, and a bias toward shipping
